name: Matthew Downs
bio: Matthew Downs is an award-winning filmmaker, film producer, film festival programmer, and the co-host and co-creator of Fantasy Filmball. Often described as an encyclopedia of movies, and sometimes described as “more movie than person”, Matthew’s gravestone will likely feature his letterboxd top 4. Alongside hosting Fantasy Filmball and generally being an idiot talking about movies on the internet, Matthew works as the Head of Programming at the Forest City Film Festival. Additionally, Matthew is currently pursuing his MFA in Film Production at New York University, where he hopes to one day make Spike Lee proud (Go Knicks!) Follow Matthew on Awards Expert: @mattydraps
